desc: Derive the precise DP state and transition rules for a rooted subtree, including the special case K = 1.
Prove why every feasible decomposition corresponds to the proposed bottom-up fragment-combination process.
Design an iterative DFS/postorder implementation safe for up to 200,000 vertices.
Check edge cases: a single path, stars, root handling, and vertices receiving multiple child fragments.
Implement the stdin/stdout solution in Python and verify its time complexity is O(NK).
